title: 🌿 Invitation to the seminar “Green Economy Models in the Educational Process of the Kyrgyz Republic: Experience and Prospects”

blocks.text: The seminar will consider approaches to integrating green economy principles into Kyrgyzstan’s higher education system, present best practices and discuss prospects for universities and educators. 🎓 The event is intended for teachers, researchers, students and everyone interested in sustainable development and education.
